Files never leave this device

Merge PDF files into one document

Add two or more PDFs, put them in order and download a single file. Pages are copied as they are, so text stays selectable and quality does not change.

How to merge PDF files

  1. Choose or drop the PDF files you want to combine.
  2. Drag the files, or use the arrows, to set their order.
  3. Select Merge and download.

How your files are handled

Your files are opened, changed and saved by this browser tab. Nothing is uploaded, and the original file on your device is never modified. Closing the tab discards everything, so download your result first.

Questions

Are my files uploaded?
No. Everything runs in your browser with PDF.js and pdf-lib. Your documents are never sent to a server.
Will merging reduce quality?
No. Pages are copied into the new file without re-rendering, so text, images and links inside the pages are kept as they were.
How many files can I merge?
Up to 20 files, 100 MB combined and 200 pages in the merged document.
Can I merge password-protected PDFs?
Not yet. Remove the password in the app that created the file, then merge the unlocked copy.
Is it free?
Yes. There is no account, no watermark, no daily limit and no paid tier.
